context: Hina comes home from school hungry. Yumiko has prepared a small snack.
purpose: small domestic tenderness — daily rhythm of mother and small child

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ただいまー！お腹すいたー！
lines.style: High child returning energy, the dramatic hunger announcement bright and full, complete childish trust in the home.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おかえり。おやつあるよ。
lines.style: Warm maternal greeting steady, the gentle predictable comfort in the daily ritual carried through softly.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: High child excitement burst with eager curiosity, complete pivot from hunger to anticipation in delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: りんごと、ちょっとクッキー。
lines.style: Maternal casual offering, the small bribe of cookies tucked in lovingly, comfortable home-cadence throughout.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: りんご大好き！いただきまーす！
lines.en: I love apples! Thank you for the food!
lines.style: High child enthusiastic declaration plus polite ritual phrase, the energy carrying both fully through delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Soft maternal gentle reminder, the small daily warning of love about choking floating gently into the moment.
